completion_gate: A capability is not complete until its authored semantics, static fallback, participation path, privacy exclusions, and required tests are defined and verified by its owning story.
global_invariants: Native pages and legacy posts remain backward compatible unless an explicit migration is approved.
Derived output never rewrites canonical authored content.
Failures are scoped to the source and capability or object; they do not publish private data or mutate remote state.
Portable output excludes drafts, private notes, private participant revisions, credentials, and unapproved material.
Every interactive or graphical representation has a useful static equivalent or an explicit decision to remain unavailable.

authored_data: Stable work and edition identities, including translation and witness relationships
Source-specific text or bounded passage references
Translator/editor/contributor attribution, rights, and uncertainty
contracts.static_fallback: A labeled sequence or table of the available passages with edition/translation identity, attribution, rights notice, and source links. Do not imply that a translation is an original work or merge separate witnesses into one text.
contracts.participation_path: Link each passage and attribution to its identified source; comparison controls are optional enhancements.
privacy_exclusions: Private research notes and unpublished comparisons
Unlicensed source text beyond the explicitly approved quotation
required_tests: Round-trip edition, translation, work, witness, attribution, rights, and uncertainty without collapsing identities
Render a readable labeled comparison with JavaScript and CSS disabled
Reject or omit private and unlicensed material without changing canonical source data
contracts.scope_boundary: The owner story defines the semantic model and rights boundary; the comparison workspace and public renderer are owned by its child tasks.

authored_data: Events and temporal relations with source attribution
Precision, ranges, uncertainty, and competing dates
contracts.static_fallback: A deterministic ordered list or table of events, retaining date precision, uncertainty, competing dates, and source links. A visual timeline may enhance but never replace that list.
contracts.participation_path: Provide ordinary links to source evidence and related published articles; timeline controls are optional.
privacy_exclusions: Draft events and unpublished research
Private annotations and unapproved chronology proposals
required_tests: Round-trip exact, ranged, approximate, and unknown dates without coercing uncertainty
Preserve competing dates and their source attribution
Verify deterministic list order, accessible labels, and working source links without JavaScript
contracts.scope_boundary: Temporal modeling and uncertainty are owned by the contract task; the Admin explorer and public timeline remain separate child tasks.

authored_data: Stable source and reference identities
Author-selected passages, citations, and publication context
Explicit publication decisions for research material
contracts.static_fallback: Published citations and selected context render as attributed text with source links. Private research workspace state has no public fallback and is omitted until explicitly selected for publication.
contracts.participation_path: Each public citation links to the source or reference; workspace controls are author-only and are not required for reading.
privacy_exclusions: Private notes, imported source caches, unsaved drafts, and source credentials
Unselected or unapproved research material
required_tests: Build feeds, exports, search, and pages from the same explicit public manifest
Prove private and draft material is absent from every public surface
Verify failed selection or publication leaves canonical content and private workspace state unchanged
contracts.scope_boundary: The research story owns workflow integration; the private-to-public manifest task owns disclosure policy, and citation/source identities are reused rather than redefined.

authored_data: A stable citation/reference identity and source URL
Version identity and precise page, section, or passage location where available
Visible citation label and attribution
contracts.static_fallback: Every citation resolves to a visible reference entry and ordinary source link. If preview loading fails or is unavailable, retain the citation, location, and link; do not require an embedded preview.
contracts.participation_path: The source link is the canonical path; preview activation is optional and must not be the only route to the cited material.
privacy_exclusions: Remote page bodies, credentials, reader identifiers, and tracking state
Private research references not selected for publication
required_tests: Resolve citations to visible reference entries with distinguishable version and location identity
Test keyboard/screen-reader access and no-JavaScript anchor navigation
Test URL scheme validation, hostile responses, source failure, Unicode labels, and fragment anchors
contracts.scope_boundary: The citation contract and existing reference identity are owned by the reader story; preview transport and component behavior remain in its child tasks.

authored_data: Canonical prose and citations
Author-approved supplemental blocks with kind, label, order, and intended reading depth
contracts.static_fallback: Canonical prose remains unchanged. All approved supplements appear as labeled, ordered static sections; reading-mode controls may change visibility only and cannot replace or rewrite the canonical argument.
contracts.participation_path: Ordinary citation/source links remain available in every mode; mode selection is a local presentation control.
privacy_exclusions: Unapproved supplements, private author notes, and hidden drafting state
AI-generated commentary without explicit human review and approval
required_tests: Assert canonical prose and citations are byte-identical across modes
Verify supplement labels, order, links, and readable static output without JavaScript
Verify unknown supplement kinds degrade to visible text and failures stay scoped to that block
contracts.scope_boundary: The contract task owns supplement semantics and mode invariants; controls and rendering are implemented by separate child tasks.

authored_data: Stable concept/entity identity and typed, directed relationships
Evidence/source attribution for each relationship
Public visibility and publication status
contracts.static_fallback: Every graph view has an equivalent labeled list or table of published entities and directed relationships, with evidence links and relationship direction stated in text.
contracts.participation_path: Entity and evidence links resolve to published canonical pages or sources; graph interaction is optional.
privacy_exclusions: Private or draft Atlas records and unpublished relationship edges
Queries or traversal paths outside the published projection
required_tests: Prove public queries cannot traverse to private or draft nodes
Round-trip relationship direction, source identity, labels, and ordering
Compare graph and static-list semantics and test useful no-JavaScript output
contracts.scope_boundary: The projection contract owns public query boundaries; concept authoring, previews, and relationship trails belong to the linked child tasks.

authored_data: Ordered published works and author-authored transitions
A reason or learning purpose for each transition
contracts.static_fallback: Render the path as an ordered list with each transition reason and ordinary links to the selected works. A path remains distinct from a series.
contracts.participation_path: Each step links to its canonical work; missing or unavailable works retain an explicit, non-broken explanation.
privacy_exclusions: Private or draft works, reader-specific annotations, and unpublished curation
Inferred transitions presented as author-approved
required_tests: Verify order, transition reasons, source links, and distinction from series
Test missing steps degrade with a scoped diagnostic and readable static output
Prove reader-private state is not included in public path metadata
contracts.scope_boundary: The reading-path contract owns author intent and transition semantics; curation UI and public discovery remain separate tasks.

authored_data: Stable passage target and stale-target state
Bounded quoted context, feedback type, source evidence, and submitter provenance
Moderation and response status
contracts.static_fallback: Published, approved feedback and revision notes render as attributed text linked to the passage. Without a submission backend, reading remains complete and the form gives a clear explanation or canonical contact path.
contracts.participation_path: A submission control targets the stable passage and optional hosted endpoint; a failed or absent endpoint must not change the article or lose the source link.
privacy_exclusions: Pending, rejected, removed, or private submissions from public feeds and exports
Authentication tokens, reader identifiers, abuse reports, and private moderation notes
required_tests: Resolve current and stale passage targets without mutating prose
Bound and escape quoted context and preserve feedback provenance separately from research notes
Verify pending-by-default moderation, rate limits, no-JavaScript reading, and no private-data leakage
contracts.scope_boundary: The passage/provenance contract is owned by this task; transport, form, and moderation reuse the shared participation and moderation policy.

authored_data: Reader-owned highlight/note content and a stable text selector
Selector exact/prefix/suffix context and current/stale resolution state
Explicit user-initiated export scope
contracts.static_fallback: Annotations are private local enhancements, not canonical article content. The article remains fully readable without them; an explicit export is a separate user-controlled file, not a public page/feed representation.
contracts.participation_path: The article remains the canonical reading destination; annotation controls are optional and local.
privacy_exclusions: Annotations from generated pages, feeds, search indexes, syndication, and shared moderation
Cross-device or remote sync unless a separately approved contract adds it
required_tests: Verify annotations do not mutate source Markdown or rendered canonical content
Test exact/prefix/suffix resolution, stale state, Unicode, and selector mismatch
Verify import/export validation and explicit privacy scope, with no automatic network transmission
contracts.scope_boundary: The local annotation contract owns storage and selector semantics; it is separate from research notes, citations, and public feedback.

authored_data: Attributed interpretations, evidence links, audience level, and provenance
Explicit human approval state for generated or assisted explanations
contracts.static_fallback: Render interpretations as separately labeled, attributed sections with citations. Preserve disagreements side by side; audience level supplements and never replaces canonical prose.
contracts.participation_path: Each interpretation links to its cited evidence and contributor identity; comparison controls are optional.
privacy_exclusions: Unapproved AI output, private drafts, hidden prompts, and participant identity data
Any presentation that marks one interpretation correct without an explicit, attributable editorial decision
required_tests: Verify contradictory interpretations can coexist with their attribution and evidence
Assert audience modes leave canonical prose unchanged and provide static labeled output
Verify AI provenance, human approval, and private-draft exclusion across pages, feeds, and exports
contracts.scope_boundary: The attribution and explanation contract is owned by this task; authoring and comparison interfaces are delegated to the child stories.

authored_data: Original source title, URL, type, and stable identity
Exact approved reflection revisions, contributor credits, takeaways, and open questions
contracts.static_fallback: Publish approved reflections, credits, source attribution, takeaways, and open questions as ordinary readable sections. Unsupported embeds degrade to a visible source link; feeds and exports contain approved public data only.
contracts.participation_path: Provide a working link to the original source. Participation and invitations are not required to read the published assembly.
privacy_exclusions: Protected contribution drafts, reveal state, invitations, approval metadata, and private collaboration identifiers
Unapproved revisions and optional provider metadata that would overwrite author input
required_tests: Verify title/link/type and attribution survive native, feed, Markdown, and HTML output
Test unsupported embeds degrade to ordinary links
Prove only exact approved revisions appear in pages, feeds, and exports
contracts.scope_boundary: The source-led reflection story owns the public assembly; source records and contributor credits reuse their existing identity contracts.

authored_data: Privately owned contribution revisions, author binding, and revision timestamp
Separate reveal and publication-approval state
contracts.static_fallback: No public fallback exists for a private draft. It is omitted from every public representation until an exact revision is approved and published through the shared-reflection contract.
contracts.participation_path: The private editor is available only to an authorized participant; public readers receive no draft URL or preview.
privacy_exclusions: All protected prose, reveal state, participant bindings, and private revision metadata from pages, feeds, exports, search, and public previews
required_tests: Verify one participant cannot read or overwrite another protected revision
Test server-enforced reveal separately from exact-revision publication approval
Prove private prose never appears in previews, feeds, exports, or error messages
contracts.scope_boundary: The privacy/revision contract is owned by this task; protected draft UX and approval workflow remain with their separate child stories.

authored_data: A reader's approved reflection on a published work or one of its sections, with its optional prompt category
The passage revision and target the reader wrote about, and the target's standing in the work now
The reader's name only while the approved and the current consent show it and it matches no credited name
contracts.static_fallback: The canonical page lists approved Third Perspectives as static, semantic text after the authors' work, each headed as a reader's and never an author's. Portable copies, feeds and llms files carry only a labelled link to the canonical page, never the reflections. Without a hosted service the page keeps what was approved and the form's static text is a copy-and-contact path.
contracts.participation_path: The canonical page offers the progressive form where the kind is open; elsewhere the labelled canonical link is the only participation path, and a reader checks on a reflection only through their private receipt.
privacy_exclusions: Pending, clarification, rejected, removed, withdrawn and deleted reflections, and any reflection whose consent no longer allows publication
Receipts and their digests, consent records, private names, moderators, reasons, the reader's clock, channel and hosted ids beyond the public report handle
required_tests: Prove the published file and every portable, feed, search and llms output carry no private field and no reflection text
Verify the name follows the approved and current consent and is withheld when it matches a credited name, including look-alike spellings
Verify published-mode gating without a transport, stale and moved section targets, and the receipt's status without enumeration
contracts.scope_boundary: Story #201 owns the reflection, consent, moderation and canonical rendering; issue #222 owns this portability gate. Featured placement belongs to RD14.

authored_data: No diagram data model or authored syntax is defined; a future owner story must name nodes, relationships, labels, evidence, and rights before implementation.
contracts.static_fallback: Do not add a diagram-specific syntax or public renderer without an owner story. Existing Markdown images/raw HTML remain unchanged; any future graphical interaction must provide an equivalent labeled list or table.
contracts.participation_path: Not applicable until a diagram owner story defines whether the diagram links to published entities or sources.
privacy_exclusions: Do not publish diagrams derived from private/draft graph data or unapproved remote/AI content.
required_tests: Before unblocking, create an owning story and portability task with substantive data, fallback, participation, privacy, and test requirements
Verify no diagram-specific public syntax or portability claim is introduced while this contract remains blocked
contracts.scope_boundary: This record is a scope guard only. Issue #110 is the sole owner of the unscoped gate; it does not authorize diagram implementation.
